title: Bribed majority bias identity
statement: For any nonnegative integers $k,m$ and any sign $b\in\{-1,1\}$, the fraction of inputs in the $(k+m)$-dimensional sign cube on which majority is positive after the first $k$ coordinates are set to $b$ equals the fraction of inputs $y$ in the $m$-dimensional sign cube for which the threshold function with value $+1$ when $k b+\sum_{j=1}^m y_j\ge 0$ is positive.
